name: Caideng Xuanye
source:
A young Illuminator from Earthcaress Beacon, currently residing in Rosecrown Beacon, partner of Fancia Dream. She has a straightforward personality that sometimes causes trouble. Therefore, Fancia always takes care of her.

[spoiler]In reality, Alina Nightsong is the Captain of the Arborangers. Possessing both courage and bravery, she accomplished great feats in the defense battle in Starshard Beacon and was then promoted to leader, assisting the Sages in neutralizing the threat of Darkritters and Light Pollution.[/spoiler]
